answer: The walnut ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own quartz record, and its own share of the wander quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 3261 identities would post 2873 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
